verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a knowledge store that agents read and write during their own runs. Nothing shows user-defined automations, schedules, triggers or background jobs that run autonomously. The only near match is the claim that connected sources like Slack keep Knowledge current, which is a source-sync feature rather than a way to set up autonomous automations, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
